source.label: Illustrative capacity arithmetic and official provider limits
caveats: Point counts are hypothetical, not Gujarat or India administrative counts.
One product, four variables, 72 hourly values; one separate HTTP request per point per refresh.
Provider-accounted calls may differ with batching, variables and duration; no claim that batching evades quotas.
Storage assumes every forecast snapshot retained; real storage must be measured and includes overhead.

methods.code:
requests_per_day = points * refreshes_per_day
scalar_rows_per_day = points * 4 variables * 72 hours * refreshes_per_day
